name: Sea Monster Crisis
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Drag spinach to man to make him stronger.
Tap Popeye to attack the tentacle.
Tap barbecue grill to burn the octopus.
Drag glue to his shoes to fix him in place.
Tap fishing rod to secure rope support.
Drag his hair to mast for extra strength.
Tap woman’s heels to lock her to deck.
Tap anchor to trap the tentacle.
Drag rotten fish to scare the octopus away.
